balam.name: Jaguar's Roar
balam.desc: A terrifying roar hurts nearby foes and makes them flee for 2 seconds.
balam.mech: Instant circle r190 on Balam. 40 dmg. Non-boss enemies get FEAR 2s (run directly away from Balam, cannot attack). Bosses get SLOW 35% for 2s instead. Knockback 120.
balam.vfx: Three thin amber sound-wave rings expand one after another (2 frames each) while a jaguar-head silhouette flashes above Balam. Camera shake 4px, soft vignette pulse. Palette #f2b34c / #7a3b12.
balam.sfx: Deep jaguar growl layered with a low sub-boom, 0.8s, short reverb tail.

balam.name: Obsidian Arc
balam.desc: A black-glass slash cleaves a wide arc and leaves enemies bleeding.
balam.mech: 150 degree arc in aim direction, range 150. 48 dmg + BLEED 5 dps for 4s (does not stack, refreshes). Also damages props.
balam.vfx: Black-glass crescent sweeps across the arc in 5 frames; 8 obsidian shards scatter and fade; 50 ms hit-stop. Edge highlight #9b7bff on #15121c.
balam.sfx: Sharp glassy slash plus a short stone crack.

balam.name: Prowler's Leap
balam.desc: Leap onto the nearest enemy and land with a shockwave.
balam.mech: Targets the nearest enemy within 330 (else aim direction). 0.35s jump arc, invulnerable while airborne. Landing shockwave r110: 62 dmg, knockback 150.
balam.vfx: Ground shadow shrinks as Balam rises (sprite scale 1.25), then a dust ring and 4 dirt chunks burst on landing; crack decal for 0.6s. #c58a3d / #6b4a2b.
balam.sfx: Rising whoosh, heavy thud with paw scrape.

balam.name: Claw Cyclone
balam.desc: Spin in a whirlwind of claws, shredding everything around you.
balam.mech: Balam spins for 1.5s: every 0.25s all enemies within r115 take 18 dmg (6 ticks). Move speed 60% during the spin, immune to knockback. NOT an orbit (that is Jade Halo).
balam.vfx: Balam sprite rotates through 8 frames; 3 golden claw-slash arcs trail behind him and form a ring on the ground; claws flash white on every tick. #f4c542 / #fff2b0.
balam.sfx: Looping airy whirr (1.5s) with a light claw tick per hit.

balam.name: Ceiba Breaker
balam.desc: Smash the nearest enemy with a ceiba log, stunning it.
balam.mech: Targets nearest enemy within 200. 100 dmg + STUN 1.2s (boss: 0.4s). Leaves a crater decal 1s. Absorbs the old 'Temple Quake' stun idea.
balam.vfx: A giant translucent wooden log slams down from above (3-frame overlay), bark chips and green leaves fly out, crater decal. Camera shake 6px. #6b8e3a / #3b2a1a.
balam.sfx: Heavy wood crash plus a deep thump.

balam.name: Bloodless Hunt
balam.desc: A spectral fang hunts down the healthiest enemy on screen.
balam.mech: Homing fang (speed 640, turn rate 240 deg/s) toward the HIGHEST-HP enemy within 520. 44 dmg + 8% of the target's max HP (bonus capped at 80).
balam.vfx: Cyan jaguar-fang projectile with a comet tail of pale wisps; impact shows a fang-shaped flash and 3 bite marks. #5fe3f2 / #dff9ff.
balam.sfx: Ghostly whispering whoosh, wet bite on impact.

balam.name: Stone Maw
balam.desc: Plant a stone jaw that snaps shut on the first enemies to step near it.
balam.mech: Places a jaw on the densest enemy cluster within 400. Arms after 0.4s, lasts 6s. Snaps when an enemy enters r70 or after 2.5s armed: 82 dmg in r120 + STUN 1.0s.
balam.vfx: Stone jaw rises from the ground (4 frames); armed state has a glowing sand-gold rune ring; snap = dust burst and grey shards. #8a8fa0 / #c9b37a.
balam.sfx: Grinding stone rise, huge stone clamp.

balam.name: War Drum
balam.desc: Beat a war drum: pulses damage foes and quicken your attacks.
balam.mech: 6s. Every 1s a pulse r150 deals 20 dmg. Every 3rd pulse is a big one (45 dmg, knockback 200). Balam gains +15% attack speed for the duration.
balam.vfx: A floating drum above Balam pulses on each beat; red-brown rings expand rhythmically (small, small, LARGE); pixel note glyphs radiate. #b5452b / #f0c27a.
balam.sfx: Tribal drum loop: two soft hits then one heavy, 60 bpm.

balam.name: Sun Claw
balam.desc: Four golden claw slashes burn everything around you.
balam.mech: Four crescent slashes at 90 degree spacing sweep out to r220 in 0.3s. Each enemy is hit once: 74 dmg + BURN 10 dps for 3s.
balam.vfx: Four sun-gold crescent slashes rotate outward, lens-flare sprite at the centre for 0.2s, floating embers. #ffd45a / #ff8a1f.
balam.sfx: Bright crackling flare with a sizzle.

balam.name: Jaguar Echo
balam.desc: A spectral jaguar chases and pounces on enemies for you.
balam.mech: One cyan jaguar spirit (recast replaces it) for 10s. Chases the nearest enemy and attacks every 0.7s for 10 dmg in melee range 60. Moves at 280 speed.
balam.vfx: Own 4-frame run + 3-frame pounce sprites in cyan; pale pawprint trail; blue mist puff on spawn. #5fe3f2 / #2b6f8f.
balam.sfx: Low spirit growl on spawn, soft paw loops, short bite on hit.

balam.name: Fang Path
balam.desc: Jade fangs burst from the earth in a line and slow what they hit.
balam.mech: 8 fangs erupt along 390 in the aim direction, staggered 60 ms apart. Each hit once: 54 dmg + SLOW 40% for 2s.
balam.vfx: Jade tooth spikes rise sequentially (3-frame rise each) with green dust and a faint glow line. #4fd6a0 / #d8fff0.
balam.sfx: Rapid run of bone-stone cracks rising in pitch.

balam.name: Hunter's Mark
balam.desc: Mark the 3 most dangerous enemies. They take extra damage.
balam.mech: Marks the 3 enemies with the highest threat within 360 (bosses first, then highest damage). Marked enemies take +30% damage from all sources for 6s. A marked enemy that dies restores 4 HP to Balam. Only one mark source exists in the game (allies no longer mark).
balam.vfx: Red claw-scratch glyph (3 slashes) stamped above each target and pulsing for 6s; death releases red sparks that fly to Balam. #d9413a / #ffb3a0.
balam.sfx: Three quick claw scratches, low chime when marked.

balam.name: Nine Lives
balam.desc: Heal instantly and sprint away on spirit paws.
balam.mech: Heal 26 + 20% of missing HP. +25% move speed for 4s.
balam.vfx: Nine tiny golden jaguar silhouettes spiral up from Balam and fade; warm gold aura 0.6s; small green crosses. #ffd45a / #9ef0a8.
balam.sfx: Soft choir swell with a purr.

balam.name: Black Mirror
balam.desc: Raise an obsidian mirror that throws enemy shots back at them.
balam.mech: 4s. A 120 degree arc around Balam reflects enemy projectiles at 150% damage back along their path. Melee attackers take 15 thorn damage per hit.
balam.vfx: Obsidian disc with a violet rim shimmering as a translucent 120 degree barrier; reflected shots flash violet and flip direction. #2a2540 / #b58cff.
balam.sfx: Glassy ring on cast, metallic ping per reflection.

balam.name: Pyramid Rush
balam.desc: Charge forward like a falling temple, shoving everything aside.
balam.mech: Charge 300 in 0.5s. Unstoppable (immune to stun/knockback). Enemies touched take 92 dmg once and are shoved aside (knockback 350). Ends with a small stomp r90.
balam.vfx: 5 stone-step afterimages trail behind Balam, long dust cloud line and brown speed streaks. #b08a5a / #6a4b2b.
balam.sfx: Rumbling stone drag and a charge growl.

balam.name: Heart of Balam
balam.desc: A golden ward protects you, then bursts into a roar when it ends.
balam.mech: Gain a 55-point ward for 8s (+25% per level). When the ward breaks or expires it releases a roar: 150 dmg in r200.
balam.vfx: Glowing golden jaguar heart at Balam's chest with orbiting motes; translucent gold dome; break = expanding shockwave ring and crack pattern. #ffcf4a / #c4412b.
balam.sfx: Heartbeat loop under the ward; roar plus glass shatter on break.

balam.name: Bloodlust
balam.desc: Every kill grants stacking attack speed for a short time.
balam.mech: Each kill: +x% attack speed for 3s, stacks up to 5 and each kill refreshes the timer.
balam.icon: NEW: bloody red jaguar fang with red speed lines
balam.vfx: Red claw-mark aura thickens with stacks; pips above the hero show stack count.
balam.sfx: Soft heartbeat tick per stack.
balam.icon_prompt: bloody red jaguar fang with red speed lines

balam.name: Stonehide
balam.desc: The more wounded you are, the harder your skin becomes.
balam.mech: +1 armor per 10% of missing HP, up to the listed maximum.
balam.vfx: Grey stone-plate overlay on the hero fades in as HP drops.
balam.sfx: Low stone creak when a new tier is reached.

balam.name: Predator's Rhythm
balam.desc: Critical hits shorten the cooldowns of your skills.
balam.mech: Every critical hit reduces all active skill cooldowns by x seconds (internal cooldown 1s).
balam.vfx: Gold pulse ring on the skill buttons plus a small paw flash on the hero.
balam.sfx: Short soft gong.

balam.name: Feast of the Fallen
balam.desc: Every 12 kills restore a chunk of your health.
balam.mech: Count kills; every 12th kill heals x% of max HP (counter shown as a small bar).
balam.icon: NEW: jaguar jaws biting a glowing heart
balam.vfx: Green-gold spirit wisps stream from the last victim to Balam.
balam.sfx: Soft gulp plus a chime.
balam.icon_prompt: jaguar jaws biting a glowing heart

balam.name: Obsidian Thorns
balam.desc: Enemies that hit you in melee are cut by obsidian spikes.
balam.mech: A melee hit on Balam deals x + 15% of the damage taken back to the attacker.
balam.icon: NEW: black obsidian spikes bursting from a stone skin
balam.vfx: Black shard burst at the attacker.
balam.sfx: Glass tick.
balam.icon_prompt: black obsidian spikes bursting from a stone skin

balam.name: Jaguar's Pride
balam.desc: You fight better when surrounded.
balam.mech: +x% damage for each enemy within r150 of Balam, counted up to 5 enemies.
balam.icon: NEW: golden jaguar head with a crowd of small silhouettes
balam.vfx: A thin gold ring on the ground shows the r150 radius.
balam.sfx: None (passive).
balam.icon_prompt: golden jaguar head with a crowd of small silhouettes

balam.name: Earthshaker
balam.desc: Every 4th basic attack slams the ground.
balam.mech: 4th basic attack also releases a slam r120 for x% of weapon damage with knockback 150.
balam.vfx: Small brown shockwave ring and 5 pebbles.
balam.sfx: Dull ground thump.

balam.name: Wounded Fury
balam.desc: Below half health you hit harder and steal life.
balam.mech: While HP < 50%: +x% damage and heal y% of damage dealt.
balam.vfx: Red flame outline around the hero while active.
balam.sfx: Low growl on entering the state (cooldown 8s).

ixchel.name: Copal Star
ixchel.desc: A slow jade star pierces enemies and leaves slowing copal smoke.
ixchel.mech: Star projectile speed 420, pierce 3, 52 dmg. Leaves a smoke trail for 2s that SLOWS enemies 30%.
ixchel.vfx: Five-point jade-white star spinning (4 frames) with grey-green smoke puffs left behind. #9ef0c8 / #5c6b66.
ixchel.sfx: Soft chime with a light crackle.

ixchel.name: Jade Halo
ixchel.desc: Jade beads orbit you, hurting enemies and blocking enemy shots.
ixchel.mech: 7s. 4 beads truly orbit at r125 (1 rev per 1.1s). Each bead hits an enemy once per 1.0s for 16 dmg and destroys any enemy projectile it touches.
ixchel.vfx: Polished jade beads with a faint green ring trail; contact flare; a bead-pop flash when it blocks a shot. #4fd6a0 / #e8fff6.
ixchel.sfx: Glassy bead clacks over a soft hum loop.

ixchel.name: Ancestor Flame
ixchel.desc: Blue-green spirit fire leaps between up to five enemies.
ixchel.mech: Instant chain: up to 5 enemies, jump range 200, -10% damage per jump (47 base). Every enemy hit BURNS 5 dps for 3s. Only chain skill in the game (besides the passive Ancestral Echo).
ixchel.vfx: Jagged blue-green flame arcs with a flame sprite at each node; ember flicker 0.5s. #3de0b0 / #1a6f8f.
ixchel.sfx: Crackle with a low whoosh per jump.

ixchel.name: Moonwell
ixchel.desc: Create a moon pool that slows enemies and refills your mana.
ixchel.mech: 8s zone r145 at target area. Enemies inside: SLOW 40% and 12 dmg per second. Ixchel standing inside regains 4 mana per second. (Old version only blasted once.)
ixchel.vfx: Round pool of pale-blue water with a moon reflection, ripples and rising silver sparkles; fades in the last second. #8ec5ff / #e8f2ff.
ixchel.sfx: Watery shimmer loop with a soft flute note.

ixchel.name: Censer Wave
ixchel.desc: A wave of incense smoke shoves enemies back and confuses them.
ixchel.mech: Cone 100 degrees, range 200. 50 dmg, knockback 250, CONFUSE 2s (enemies walk in random directions and do not attack).
ixchel.vfx: Rolling grey-green smoke billows fill the cone with swirling incense glyphs; a smoky ring after-image. #b8c9bd / #6f8f7f.
ixchel.sfx: Soft low whoosh with puffing exhales.

ixchel.name: Verdant Mercy
ixchel.desc: Grow a glade that heals you and your ally while you stand in it.
ixchel.mech: 6s healing circle r140 under Ixchel. Heals 8 HP per second to Ixchel and the ally inside (scaled by the heal stat). It stays where it was cast.
ixchel.vfx: Ring of green sprouts and pink flowers growing (3 frames), soft green light column, floating leaves. #7be0a0 / #ff9ccf.
ixchel.sfx: Harp glissando with a wind chime.

ixchel.name: Copal Veil
ixchel.desc: A smoke veil absorbs damage and turns part of it into mana.
ixchel.mech: 6s absorb shield of 48 points. 50% of the damage it absorbs is returned as mana.
ixchel.vfx: Translucent grey-violet smoke dome hugging Ixchel; absorbed hits become blue sparkles flying into her mana bar. #8f86b8 / #6ad0ff.
ixchel.sfx: Muffled cloth whoosh, glass ping on absorb.

ixchel.name: Glyph Comet
ixchel.desc: A jade comet crashes down a line and scorches glowing glyphs into the ground.
ixchel.mech: Comet strikes a line of 500 x 80 in front of Ixchel: 86 dmg. Leaves glyph decals for 3s that deal 6 dps to enemies standing on them.
ixchel.vfx: Green comet with a long tail streaks along the path; star burst on impact; Maya glyph decals glow along the line. #3de0b0 / #f5e6a0.

ixchel.name: Cacao Bloom
ixchel.desc: Cacao flowers burst under nearby enemies, poisoning them.
ixchel.mech: Flowers sprout under the 5 nearest enemies. After 0.8s each bursts: 48 dmg r70 + POISON 8 dps for 4s.
ixchel.vfx: Brown cacao-pod flowers open (4 frames) with pink petals and a brown spore cloud that drifts away. #7a4a2b / #ff9ccf.
ixchel.sfx: Soft pluck pop with a squelch.

ixchel.name: Raincaller
ixchel.desc: Call a storm cloud that follows enemy groups and strikes them with lightning.
ixchel.mech: 6s cloud drifting (speed 90) toward the densest group. Every 0.7s lightning hits a random enemy under it for 31 dmg, 25% chance STUN 0.6s.
ixchel.vfx: Dark blue cloud sprite with rain streaks, 2-frame yellow-white lightning bolts, puddle splashes. #3f6fb5 / #fff3a0.

ixchel.name: Spirit Familiar
ixchel.desc: A hummingbird spirit darts at enemies and feeds you mana.
ixchel.mech: 10s flying familiar (recast replaces it). Circles Ixchel, dives at the priority/ranged enemy every 0.6s for 9 dmg. Each hit restores 1 mana.
ixchel.vfx: Iridescent green-blue hummingbird (4-frame wing flap) with shimmering dust; dive streak lines. #4fe0c8 / #ff6fb0.
ixchel.sfx: Buzzing hum loop with tiny chirps.

ixchel.name: Serpent Coil
ixchel.desc: A spectral serpent drags enemies together and crushes them.
ixchel.mech: At target area r135: first PULLS enemies to the centre over 0.6s, then constricts: 76 dmg + STUN 1.0s.
ixchel.vfx: Translucent green serpent winds in a spiral (6 segments) then tightens; hiss puffs. #4fd68f / #c8ffd8.

ixchel.name: Jade Needles
ixchel.desc: Needles stick in enemies and shatter a moment later.
ixchel.mech: 10 needles in a full circle, 22 dmg each. A needle that hits sticks in the enemy and shatters 1.5s later for 50% of the hit damage in r50.
ixchel.vfx: Thin jade needles fly radially; stuck needles glow then shatter into green glass shards. #7bf0c0 / #d8fff0.
ixchel.sfx: Rapid thin whistles, glass shatter ticks.

ixchel.name: Dreamwalk
ixchel.desc: Slip into the spirit world, walk through enemies, and return with a shockwave.
ixchel.mech: 1.5s intangible (cannot take damage, passes through enemies), +40% move speed. On return: shockwave r120 for 26 dmg.
ixchel.vfx: Ixchel turns translucent blue-violet with a double afterimage and star mist; return = violet ripple ring. #9a8cff / #d8d0ff.
ixchel.sfx: Dreamy reversed-cymbal swell, soft pop on return.

ixchel.name: Four Directions
ixchel.desc: Four sacred bolts shoot north, east, south and west.
ixchel.mech: Four bolts along the cardinal axes (independent of aim), 60 dmg, pierce 5, range 560.
ixchel.vfx: A cross-shaped light appears on the ground, then four bolts leave with directional colours: east red #d9413a, north white #f2f2f2, west black with outline #1a1a1a, south yellow #ffd45a.

ixchel.name: Ixchel's Mantle
ixchel.desc: Wrap yourself in moonlight: more mana, cheaper spells.
ixchel.mech: 6s: mana regeneration x3 and all active skills cost 30% less mana.
ixchel.vfx: Silver-blue cloak of light draped over Ixchel with floating stars; mana bar glows. #8ec5ff / #f5f0ff.

ixchel.name: Ancestral Echo
ixchel.desc: Every 5th basic attack chains to nearby enemies.
ixchel.mech: The 5th basic attack chains to extra enemies within 220 at x% damage.
ixchel.vfx: Pale blue ghost-flame arcs between targets.

ixchel.name: Mana Spring
ixchel.desc: Every 15 kills refill a part of your mana.
ixchel.mech: Count kills; every 15th kill restores x mana.
ixchel.vfx: Blue droplets fly from the last victim into the mana bar.

ixchel.name: Lunar Boon
ixchel.desc: Every 20 seconds your next skill is free and stronger.
ixchel.mech: Timer ready indicator on HUD. Next active skill costs 0 mana and deals +x% damage.
ixchel.vfx: Small silver crescent glows over the skill bar when ready; consumed with a moon flash.

ixchel.name: Rooted Meditation
ixchel.desc: Stand still to channel the world tree.
ixchel.mech: After standing still 1.5s: +x% skill damage and +3 mana/s until you move.
ixchel.vfx: Tiny roots and leaves ring Ixchel's feet while active.

ixchel.name: Jade Resilience
ixchel.desc: If nothing hurts you, a jade shield slowly builds up.
ixchel.mech: If no damage was taken for 4s, gain 3 shield per second up to the listed maximum.
ixchel.icon: NEW: jade shield made of green crystal plates
ixchel.vfx: Green crystal facets stack around Ixchel as the shield grows.
ixchel.icon_prompt: jade shield made of green crystal plates

ixchel.name: Spirit Harvest
ixchel.desc: Defeated enemies sometimes release a healing wisp.
ixchel.mech: On kill, chance to drop a wisp. Touching it restores 3 HP and 4 mana.
ixchel.icon: NEW: floating pale green wisp with two small eyes
ixchel.vfx: Wisp rises from the corpse with a tiny trail; pickup sparkle.
ixchel.icon_prompt: floating pale green wisp with two small eyes

ixchel.name: Crescent Blessing
ixchel.desc: Critical hits restore mana.
ixchel.mech: Each critical hit restores x mana (internal cooldown 0.5s).
ixchel.icon: NEW: silver crescent moon with a blue sparkle
ixchel.vfx: Blue sparkle flies from the target to Ixchel.
ixchel.icon_prompt: silver crescent moon with a blue sparkle

ixchel.name: Mana Overflow
ixchel.desc: A full reservoir of mana powers your spells.
ixchel.mech: While mana is at 90% or more: +x% damage and +10% cooldown recovery speed.
ixchel.icon: NEW: overflowing blue-white goblet with energy spilling out
ixchel.vfx: Blue energy ring around the mana bar and a faint aura on Ixchel.
ixchel.icon_prompt: overflowing blue-white goblet with energy spilling out

kukul.name: Atlatl Volley
kukul.desc: A tight fan of five piercing darts.
kukul.mech: 5 darts, spread 0.13 rad, pierce 2, 20 dmg each, range 560. Close range hits with all five.
kukul.vfx: Turquoise darts with red-feather fletching, a small muzzle burst of feathers. #3fd0d0 / #d9413a.

kukul.name: Featherstorm
kukul.desc: A storm of obsidian feathers drifts forward, shredding enemies.
kukul.mech: 4s. A whirl r70 travels forward at speed 160. Enemies inside take 14 dmg every 0.4s.
kukul.vfx: Feather tornado funnel (6-frame rotation) of dark red and white feathers, feathers fly off outward. #a02a2a / #f4f0e6.
kukul.sfx: Flapping whirr loop with slicing ticks.

kukul.name: Serpent Path
kukul.desc: A jade serpent weaves through a line of enemies.
kukul.mech: One bolt that moves in a sine wave (amplitude 60), speed 600, pierce 12, 64 dmg, range 560.
kukul.vfx: Sinuous green serpent with a glowing head leaving a long wavy trail. #3de08f / #c8ffd8.

kukul.name: Windstep
kukul.desc: Dash through danger leaving a cutting wind trail.
kukul.mech: Dash 250. 26 dmg to enemies passed through. Leaves a wind trail for 2s dealing 8 dmg per 0.3s. +30% move speed for 2s.
kukul.vfx: Cyan speed streaks and a swirl sprite at the start; trail of translucent wind ribbons that fades over 2s. #6ad0ff / #e8fbff.

kukul.name: Quetzal Flip
kukul.desc: Flip away from danger while firing back.
kukul.mech: Back-flip 260 away from the nearest enemy (invulnerable during the flip) then fire 3 darts at it, 24 dmg each.
kukul.vfx: Feather-coloured arc afterimage with a burst of red and green feathers at take-off. #d9413a / #3de08f.
kukul.sfx: Feather flutter then three quick thwips.

kukul.name: Hunter's Snare
kukul.desc: Throw a woven net that roots enemies in place.
kukul.mech: Net lands at target area r120: 62 dmg and ROOT 2s (enemies cannot move but can still attack).
kukul.vfx: Brown woven net unfurls (3 frames) and drops with rope particles; sticky-grass decal. #a8743a / #3b2a1a.
kukul.sfx: Rope whip and a soft thud.

kukul.name: Eagle Eye
kukul.desc: Hold still, focus, and fire a guaranteed critical shot.
kukul.mech: 0.6s focus (Kukul stands still, crosshair shown). Then one shot: 58 dmg, guaranteed critical, pierce 3, range 760. Moving cancels the focus (no cooldown).
kukul.vfx: Golden eye icon over the target with a shrinking ring; the shot is a thin bright gold beam; white star on impact. #ffd45a / #ffffff.
kukul.sfx: Low tension riser then one sharp crack.

kukul.name: Sun Dart
kukul.desc: A golden dart bounces between enemies, hitting harder each time.
kukul.mech: Ricochet 5 times (range 280 per bounce): damage 43, then +10% on each bounce.
kukul.vfx: Golden dart with a sun-spark trail; each bounce flashes a sunburst and an angular line. #ffd45a / #ff8a1f.
kukul.sfx: Metal ping that rises in pitch on each bounce.

kukul.name: Storm Nest
kukul.desc: A feather nest that shoots wind darts at three enemies at once.
kukul.mech: 8s stationary nest. Every 0.8s fires at up to 3 different nearest enemies (12 dmg each). Targets are never shared when 2+ enemies exist.
kukul.vfx: Nest with eggs, a small blue gale swirling above it, three thin dart lines. #7fb8ff / #a8743a.

kukul.name: Plume Guard
kukul.desc: Three feathers block the next three hits.
kukul.mech: 8s. Negates the next 3 separate instances of damage (projectile, melee or contact).
kukul.vfx: Three quetzal feathers orbit the hero; each absorbed hit pops one in a green flash. #3de08f / #d9413a.
kukul.sfx: Soft feather flutter, chime on absorb.

kukul.name: Cacao Bomb
kukul.desc: Lob a clay cacao bomb that explodes with beans.
kukul.mech: Lobbed in a 0.7s arc to a target within 400. Explodes r150: 73 dmg, knockback 200.
kukul.vfx: Clay pot with a lit fuse arcing, ground shadow; brown-orange blast with cacao bean shrapnel. #a85a2a / #ffb347.

kukul.name: Forked Flight
kukul.desc: One dart splits into three that each hunt a different target.
kukul.mech: A dart flies for 0.4s, then splits into 3 homing darts (30 dmg each) that choose different targets when possible.
kukul.vfx: A single turquoise dart splits with a fork flash into three with curved trails. #3fd0d0 / #ffffff.

kukul.name: Gale Ring
kukul.desc: A wind ring blasts enemies away and speeds you up.
kukul.mech: Ring expands to r250. 46 dmg, knockback 330. Kukul gains +25% move speed for 3s.
kukul.vfx: Translucent white-blue expanding ring carrying leaf debris. #cfeaff / #6ad0ff.

kukul.name: Hunter's Trance
kukul.desc: Enter a trance: faster, more critical, and darts curve toward targets.
kukul.mech: 6s: +30% attack speed, +20% crit chance, projectiles bend slightly toward enemies.
kukul.vfx: Kukul's eyes glow gold; a faint crosshair reticle orbits him.

kukul.name: Skyfall
kukul.desc: A rain of heavy darts falls over a wide area.
kukul.mech: 0.6s red telegraph circles. Then 12 darts over 1.5s across r360, 40 dmg each, impact r50.
kukul.vfx: Red telegraph circles, darkened sky overlay, darts with smoke trails, dust on impacts; camera shake 8px. #d9413a / #3b2a1a.
kukul.sfx: Distant whistling rain of darts and impacts.

kukul.name: Kukulkan's Breath
kukul.desc: Channel a feathered-serpent beam through a line of enemies.
kukul.mech: Channel 1.5s (Kukul moves at 50% speed). Beam 520 x 60. Hits every 0.15s for 16 dmg.
kukul.vfx: Quetzal serpent head at the origin breathes a beam of green, turquoise and gold with flowing scales. #3de08f / #ffd45a.
kukul.sfx: Sustained roaring wind layered with chimes.

kukul.name: Sharpened Flint
kukul.desc: Your projectiles pierce more enemies.
kukul.mech: Adds x to the pierce of all basic and skill projectiles.
kukul.vfx: White glint on dart tips.

kukul.name: Venomous Darts
kukul.desc: Your basic darts poison enemies.
kukul.mech: Each basic hit applies POISON (x dps for 3s, up to 3 stacks).
kukul.vfx: Green droplets on poisoned enemies.

kukul.name: Full Quiver
kukul.desc: Every 6th shot fires a spread of darts.
kukul.mech: The 6th basic attack fires x darts in a spread.
kukul.vfx: Quiver sprite flashes on the 6th shot.

kukul.name: Hunter's Focus
kukul.desc: Keep hitting the same enemy to deal more damage.
kukul.mech: +x% damage per consecutive hit on the same enemy. Switching target resets stacks.
kukul.icon: NEW: crosshair over a hawk eye
kukul.vfx: Small crosshair pips above the target.

kukul.name: Fleet Hunter
kukul.desc: After a dash, your next shot hits much harder.
kukul.mech: After Dash, Windstep or Quetzal Flip: the next basic attack within 3s deals +x% damage.
kukul.vfx: White wind swirl on the dart.
kukul.sfx: Quick whoosh on the next shot.

kukul.name: Jungle Instinct
kukul.desc: Sometimes you simply are not there when the hit lands.
kukul.mech: x% chance to completely avoid any hit.
kukul.vfx: Leaf burst and a ghost afterimage when dodging.

kukul.name: Trophy Hunter
kukul.desc: Killing a tough enemy or boss heals you and strengthens you.
kukul.mech: Killing a jaguar, priest or any boss restores 20% max HP and grants +x% damage for 20s.
kukul.icon: NEW: jaguar skull trophy on a spear
kukul.vfx: Gold feather burst on the kill.
kukul.icon_prompt: jaguar skull trophy on a spear

kukul.name: Steady Aim
kukul.desc: Stand still to line up critical shots.
kukul.mech: After standing still 1s: +x% crit chance until you move.
kukul.icon: NEW: small sniper reticle in a green circle
kukul.vfx: Thin reticle ring around Kukul while active.
kukul.icon_prompt: small sniper reticle in a green circle

shared.name: Survivor's Will
shared.desc: Taking a hit makes you run faster for a moment.
shared.mech: Every hero starts with this. +x% move speed for 2s after taking damage (cooldown 6s).
shared.icon: NEW: running footprints with a small heart
shared.vfx: Quick speed streaks behind the hero.
shared.icon_prompt: running footprints with a small heart

shared.name: Jade Bounty
shared.desc: Collecting experience gems heals you and pulls them in from afar.
shared.mech: Every hero starts with this. XP gems restore x HP and are attracted from x% farther (base radius is 170 in GameScene).

saintess.name: Healing Circle
saintess.desc: Creates a healing circle under the hero.
saintess.mech: Circle r150 under the hero for 5s, heals 8 HP per second (x ally power).
saintess.icon: NEW: green ring of lotus petals around a glowing cross
saintess.vfx: Jade ring with rotating petals and soft light pillars.

saintess.icon_prompt: green ring of lotus petals around a glowing cross

saintess.icon: NEW: hexagonal jade shield with a green gem
saintess.vfx: Jade hexagon flash around the hero.
saintess.icon_prompt: hexagonal jade shield with a green gem

saintess.name: Cleansing Light
saintess.desc: Clears enemy projectiles and removes ailments.
saintess.mech: Removes enemy projectiles within r210 and cleanses slow, poison, bleed, burn and confuse from the hero. 2s immunity to slows.
saintess.icon: NEW: white-gold sun cross with falling feathers
saintess.vfx: White-gold light wave ring with feather particles.
saintess.auto: hero has a debuff or 3+ enemy projectiles near
saintess.icon_prompt: white-gold sun cross with falling feathers

saintess.name: Sanctuary Dome
saintess.desc: Raises a dome that reduces damage inside.
saintess.mech: Dome r130 centred on the hero for 5s. Damage taken by the hero inside is reduced by 30%.
saintess.vfx: Hexagon panes of pale gold light.

saintess.name: Radiant Beacon
saintess.desc: Plants a beacon that makes the hero faster and more agile.
saintess.mech: Beacon at the hero for 8s. Hero within r150: +20% attack speed and +10% move speed.
saintess.icon: NEW: golden light pillar on a stone base
saintess.vfx: Golden pillar with rising sparks and a spinning sun glyph.
saintess.icon_prompt: golden light pillar on a stone base

saintess.name: Lifebond

saintess.icon: NEW: red-gold thread connecting two small hearts
saintess.vfx: Red-gold thread of light with floating hearts.
saintess.icon_prompt: red-gold thread connecting two small hearts

saintess.name: Saving Grace
saintess.desc: Once in a while prevents a fatal blow.

saintess.icon: NEW: white wings spread around a golden halo
saintess.vfx: White-gold wings spread behind the hero, feather burst.
saintess.icon_prompt: white wings spread around a golden halo

saintess.name: Sacred Fervor
saintess.desc: The saintess inspires the hero to hit harder.
saintess.mech: Hero deals +x% damage while the saintess is alive.
saintess.vfx: Soft gold glow on the hero's weapon.

tank.name: Bulwark Wall

tank.vfx: Stone slabs rise one by one (4 frames), dust at the base.
tank.auto: enemy projectiles heading to the hero
tank.icon_prompt: grey stone wall segment with carved Maya glyphs

tank.name: War Cry

tank.icon: NEW: open mouth shouting with red sound waves
tank.vfx: Red-gold sound rings centred on the tank.
tank.icon_prompt: open mouth shouting with red sound waves

tank.name: Shield Bash
tank.desc: Bashes the biggest threat and stuns it.
tank.mech: Targets the highest-threat enemy: 16 dmg + STUN 0.7s.
tank.icon: NEW: round stone shield with a spike hitting a spark
tank.vfx: Quick shield-shaped impact flash and white stars.
tank.icon_prompt: round stone shield with a spike hitting a spark

tank.name: Ground Slam
tank.desc: Slams the ground, stunning enemies around.
tank.icon: NEW: stone fist striking cracked ground
tank.vfx: Brown shockwave ring with debris flying up.

tank.name: Clay Bomb
tank.mech: Bomb placed near the hero; explodes r135 when an enemy is within 60 or after 3s: 32 dmg.

tank.vfx: Pot with lit fuse; terracotta-coloured blast.
tank.icon_prompt: round clay pot with a spark fuse

tank.name: Shield Throw

tank.icon_prompt: spinning stone disc with motion arcs

tank.vfx: Thin stone-grey ring under the hero.

tank.name: Guardian Link

tank.icon: NEW: two shields joined by a glowing chain
tank.vfx: Faint chain of light between hero and tank; spark when redirecting.
tank.icon_prompt: two shields joined by a glowing chain

assassin.name: Ambush

assassin.mech: Blinks next to the highest-threat enemy: 34 dmg. Double damage if used within 3s of Vanish or Smoke Bomb.
assassin.vfx: Shadowy blink afterimage then a quick blade X slash.

assassin.name: Execute
assassin.mech: 22 dmg, or 65 dmg if the target has less than 35% HP. A kill refunds 2s of this cooldown.
assassin.icon: NEW: red skull with a dagger through it
assassin.vfx: Red slash with a skull flash on kills.
assassin.icon_prompt: red skull with a dagger through it

assassin.name: Venom Blade
assassin.mech: POISON 5 dps for 5s on the top threat, stacks up to 3.
assassin.vfx: Green droplets and a small skull puff.

assassin.icon: NEW: faded silhouette dissolving into smoke
assassin.vfx: Hero becomes translucent with a shimmering outline; smoke puff.
assassin.sfx: Soft whoosh and a fading echo.

assassin.name: Relentless Pursuit
assassin.mech: Assassin basic attacks are x% faster.
assassin.icon: NEW: running wolf-like figure with speed lines
assassin.vfx: Subtle red speed lines behind the assassin.
assassin.icon_prompt: running wolf-like figure with speed lines
